prohibited_inferences: Do not attribute the cited 86.5% total annualized cost result solely to waste heat; the study reports 17% waste-heat synergy in its case.
Do not assume direct feedwater preheat reduces RO SEC without a validated temperature/salinity/pressure process model.
Do not count waste heat as free or saleable without a real time-matched sink and all parasitic electrical/thermal burdens.
Do not award potable-water credit without independent quality and intended-use evidence.
Do not double count heat as both recovered service and seawater discharge.
Do not transfer the dual-purpose seawater evaporation paper's modeled freshwater rates as guaranteed commercial output.
Do not infer local water demand or desalination need from national water-stress context without site demand evidence.
